en: Fixed `/loop` status updates in self-paced mode often not being shown because Claude wrote them only in its reasoning; Claude now writes each update, and the outcome when the loop stops, as visible text
zh: 修复了自定节奏模式下 `/loop` 状态更新经常不显示的问题，原因是 Claude 仅在其推理中写入这些更新；现在 Claude 会将每次更新以及循环停止时的结果写为可见文本
